Excellent! All 328 tests pass. The duplicate customer merge feature is complete with:

- **mergeCustomers(customers, invoices, fromId, intoId)** in src/customers.js that merges one customer into another
- Removes the fromId customer from the customers array
- Updates all invoices belonging to fromId to belong to intoId
- Returns ok({ customers, invoices }) with immutable updates
- Error handling: CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND for unknown ids, SAME_CUSTOMER when trying to merge a customer into itself
- Supports normalized customer IDs (case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed)
- 16 new tests covering: error cases, customer removal, invoice updates, immutability preservation, normalized ids, and edge cases with multiple invoices and different invoice statuses
